name: InvenTree
description: Open source inventory management system for parts tracking, stock control, and manufacturing.
composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      INVENTREE_DB_ENGINE: django.db.backends.postgresql
      INVENTREE_DB_HOST: "{{serviceName}}-postgres"
      INVENTREE_DB_NAME: inventree
      INVENTREE_DB_USER: inventree
      INVENTREE_CACHE_HOST: "{{serviceName}}-redis"
      INVENTREE_DB_PASSWORD: {{env.INVENTREE_DB_PASSWORD}}
      INVENTREE_SECRET_KEY: {{env.INVENTREE_SECRET_KEY}}
      INVENTREE_ADMIN_PASSWORD: {{env.INVENTREE_ADMIN_PASSWORD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/data:/home/inventree/data
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
      - {{serviceName}}-redis
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: inventree
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.INVENTREE_DB_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: inventree
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
  {{serviceName}}-redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-redis
    restart: unless-stopped
